decisive_items: Granulomatous inflammation with intense neutrophilic abscesses in subcutaneous fat
Widespread fibrinoid exudates within deeper tissues
Striking infiltration of the eyelids and periorbital skin with multiple firm tumorous swellings of the forehead and temples
response.rationale: R1 best matches the periorbital tumorous infiltration and deep biopsy findings of granulomatous inflammation, neutrophilic abscesses, fibrinoid exudates, and dermal histiocytes. R2 captures only the granulomatous component without the periorbital/mucin/fibrinoid pattern; R4 and R3 lack the characteristic granulomatous neutrophilic abscesses and specific skin findings.

rejected.why: Sjögren's syndrome does not explain the granulomatous neutrophilic abscesses, periorbital tumorous swellings, or deep dermal mucin.
Relapsing polychondritis lacks cartilage involvement and does not account for the rippled skin, mucin deposition, or neutrophilic abscesses.
Erdheim-Chester disease only partially matches the granulomatous inflammation but lacks the periorbital tumorous pattern, fibrinoid exudates, and deep dermal mucin.
